text: This report recommends the 2025 meeting schedule for the Property Standards Committee - North York Panel. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council's approved schedule, and the availability of virtual meeting space.

The Property Standards Committee - North York Panel: 1. Approved the following 2025 meeting dates: Wednesday, January 15, 2025 Wednesday, February 26, 2025 Wednesday, March 19, 2025 Wednesday, April 16, 2025 Wednesday, May 14, 2025 Wednesday, June 25, 2025 Wednesday, July 23, 2025 Wednesday, September 10, 2025 Wednesday, October 08, 2025 Wednesday, November 05, 2025 Wednesday, December 10, 2025
